# Portfolio Simulator

> Free, no-login, client-side tool to backtest Indian investments on real historical data: mutual funds, NSE indices, stocks and ETFs, PPF, EPF, fixed-return assets and inflation. It shows rolling returns (XIRR) and volatility for lumpsum and monthly SIP investments.

Base URL: https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator

The page is a JavaScript app, so fetching it returns no results. What an agent can do is build a URL that opens a ready-made simulation and give that link to the user. Every simulation is fully defined by its URL.

## Pages

- [Lumpsum simulator](https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/lumpsum): rolling returns of a one-time investment, comparing one or more portfolios
- [SIP simulator](https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/sip): rolling XIRR of a monthly SIP, with optional rebalancing and annual step-up
- [Historical values](https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/historical): NAV or price history of one or more assets on one chart

## Asset codes

An asset is written as `type:id`.

| Asset | Code | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Indian mutual fund | `mf:<AMFI scheme code>` | `mf:122639` (Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth) |
| NSE index | `idx:<index name, spaces as underscores>` | `idx:NIFTY_50`, `idx:NIFTY_NEXT_50` |
| Stock or ETF | `yahoo:<Yahoo Finance symbol>` | `yahoo:RELIANCE.NS`, `yahoo:AAPL` |
| Fixed annual return | `fixed:<percent>` | `fixed:7` |
| Government scheme | `gov:ppf` or `gov:epf` | `gov:ppf` |
| Inflation (CPI) | `inflation:IND` or `inflation:USA` | `inflation:IND` |

- Find mutual fund scheme codes with `https://api.mfapi.in/mf/search?q=<name>`.
- Valid index names are the `indextype` values in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asrajavel/mf-index-data/main/index%20list.json

## Portfolios

A portfolio is a comma-separated list of `type:id:allocation`, where allocations are percentages that add up to 100. Several portfolios are separated by `;` and are compared on the same chart.

Example, two portfolios: `idx:NIFTY_50:100;idx:NIFTY_50:60,gov:ppf:40`

## Lumpsum: `/lumpsum`

- `lumpsumPortfolios`: portfolios as above
- `years`: rolling period in years, 1 to 20 (default 5)
- `lumpsumAmount`: amount invested, in rupees (default 100000)
- `convertToINR=0`: optional, keeps foreign assets in their own currency

Example: https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/lumpsum?lumpsumPortfolios=idx:NIFTY_50:100;idx:NIFTY_50:60,gov:ppf:40&years=10&lumpsumAmount=100000

## SIP: `/sip`

- `portfolios`: portfolios as above, each followed by `|rebalance|threshold|stepUp|stepUpPercent`
  - `rebalance`: `1` to rebalance back to the target allocation, else `0`
  - `threshold`: allocation drift, in percentage points, that triggers a rebalance (default 5)
  - `stepUp`: `1` to raise the SIP amount every year, else `0`
  - `stepUpPercent`: yearly raise in percent (default 5)
- `years`: rolling period in years, 1 to 20 (default 5)
- `sipAmount`: monthly amount, in rupees (default 10000)
- `convertToINR=0`: optional, as above

Example, Nifty 50 against a mutual fund: https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/sip?portfolios=idx:NIFTY_50:100|0|5|0|5;mf:122639:100|0|5|0|5&years=5&sipAmount=10000

Example, a 70/30 mix with rebalancing and a 10% yearly step-up: https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/sip?portfolios=idx:NIFTY_50:70,fixed:7:30|1|5|1|10&years=7&sipAmount=25000

## Historical values: `/historical`

- `assets`: assets separated by `;`, with no allocation
- `logScale`: `1` for a logarithmic axis (default), `0` for linear

Example: https://asrajavel.github.io/portfolio-simulator/historical?assets=idx:NIFTY_50;mf:122639;inflation:IND&logScale=1

## Notes

- Results are computed in the user's browser; the SIP simulation takes a few seconds.
- Returns are historical and are not a prediction or investment advice.
- Source code: https://github.com/asrajavel/portfolio-simulator
